drums.description: Funk-rock instrumental, A clean, rhythmic electric guitar plays a syncopated 16th-note scratch riff, The bass guitar follows a repetitive, percussive slap-and-pop pattern, Drums feature a tight, dry snare and a steady kick drum with occasional open hi-hat accents, A bright, staccato brass section consisting of trumpet and saxophone enters with punchy, rhythmic stabs, The tempo is 115 BPM in the key of E minor, The arrangement is built on a static harmonic groove with a prominent cowbell hit on the upbeat of beat four in certain measures, A wah-wah guitar effect is applied to secondary melodic licks, The mix is dry with minimal reverb, emphasizing the rhythmic interplay between the percussion and the bass Publish

bass.description: Funk-rock instrumental, A prominent, distorted electric bass plays a syncopated, percussive riff featuring hammer-ons and slides, A clean electric guitar provides rhythmic staccato chords on the off-beats, The drum kit maintains a steady groove with a crisp snare and active hi-hat patterns, A wah-wah filtered guitar enters later, adding rhythmic texture with muted strums and melodic flourishes, The track is in the key of E minor at 105 BPM, The arrangement is centered around a repetitive, interlocking groove between the bass and drums, with occasional fills and variations in the guitar layers, The production is dry with minimal reverb, emphasizing the rhythmic precision of the performances Publish
